description: Retrieve the metadata, edition, citations, evidence status and limits for one public LrrK record. Request a Letter footnote by its printed number, or pass nextCitationPage as citationPage with the same kind and id. Use the returned revision to pin a later lookup. Historical Intelligence Products expose public metadata and their owner handoff only.

citationPage.description: Copy nextCitationPage exactly. Omit to start at the first citation.

footnote.description: Exact numbered footnote in a Letter. Use without citationPage.

revision.description: Expected record revision. A mismatch returns no citations.

name: lrrk_get_evidence
title: Get a cited public record
